name: pattern
description: Learns how you work from every session — corrections, rejected actions, mistakes — and applies it to the next one.

interface.shortDescription: Turns your corrections into rules the agent follows next time
interface.longDescription: Pattern reads each finished session, distills the generalizable preferences behind your corrections and rejected actions, and writes them to a per-project PATTERNS.md that is injected into every later session. Ask it for its point of view with /pattern suggest, or let it take the lead with /pattern lead.
defaultPrompt: What have you learned about how I work?
How would I have approached this?
